verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents JavaScript source-map support for reversing minification (docs-11), and its official CLI uploads files to improve the stack traces in errors (docs-45, probe-4), which covers the CLI path of the story. Because the CLI evidence is generic about which files it uploads, the JS source-map upload path is only implied by combining the two docs. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the CLI uploads JS source maps, any bundler-plugin (webpack/Vite etc.) evidence, documented CI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that symbolication works.
